bugs.error_message: Error: Could not find a suitable provider for mikrotik_v7_ospf_interface_template (and other mikrotik_v7_* types) when running cli-puppet-device-full (all devices), but not when running cli-puppet-device-single --target ipt1.eadc.nairobi.rcswimax.com
bugs.root_cause: Puppet's feature system (Puppet::Util::Feature) caches feature block results globally after first evaluation. In a multi-device puppet device run, ros_v7 is evaluated when a v6 device (eadc1/eadc2, which have mikrotik_mpls_ldp_instance with both v6+v7 providers) is processed before ipt1. The v6 device causes ros_v7 to cache 'false'. When ipt1 (RouterOS 7) is reached, ros_v7 returns cached 'false', making all mikrotik_v7_* providers appear unsuitable.
bugs.fix: Added self.suitable? override to Puppet::Provider::Mikrotik_Api base class. It detects when NetworkDevice.current transport changes (new device being processed) and clears the feature cache entries for [:ros_v6, :ros_v7, :ros_v7_12, :ros_v7_pre12] from Puppet.features. This forces re-evaluation of version features for each new device. The last transport object_id is stored on the base class so the cache is cleared exactly once per device transition. NOTE: initial implementation used @values (wrong ivar) — the correct ivar is @results (Puppet::Util::Feature internal cache, both Puppet 6 and 7). Fixed 2026-05-06.

bugs.error_message: Error: Provider mikrotik_api_v6 is not functional on this host (for mikrotik_system, mikrotik_snmp_community, mikrotik_tool_email on ipt1.eadc.nairobi.rcswimax.com which is RouterOS v7)
bugs.root_cause: TIMING BUG: the suitable? override clears caches correctly, but TOO LATE. Puppet assigns providers to ALL resources upfront via type.defaultprovider (which returns the stale cached @defaultprovider without calling suitable?). By the time suitable? is called during prefetch_if_necessary, resources are already committed to the wrong (v6) provider. Puppet 6 then fails them with 'not functional' instead of re-assigning. The bug-002 fix (clearing in suitable?) only helps types that happen to be processed AFTER another type whose suitable? first triggered the clearing — a race condition.
bugs.fix: Moved the primary cache-clearing into Device#initialize (_reset_version_caches). This runs BEFORE the transaction assigns providers, so to_ral/defaultprovider sees nil @defaultprovider and calls suitable? fresh. Clears: (1) Puppet.features @results for ros_v6/v7/v7_12/v7_pre12, (2) @defaultprovider on all types whose cached provider name starts with 'mikrotik_api_v'. The suitable? override in mikrotik_api.rb is retained as a secondary defence.
